event.description: Model FF output as input transpose plus rank-7 residual
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 43 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0095/micro-0001 at 1,672 parameters/99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0128, whose symmetric output map scored 0.00% at 1,581 parameters. Hypothesis: attempts 0103 and 0128 failed because a pure transpose/symmetric relation erased directional synthesis, but the two FF maps share a transpose-aligned base plus a lower-rank directional correction. Preserve the retained 236-group input map exactly and reconstruct output as its transpose plus the best rank-7 SVD correction of the checkpoint residual; 224 correction parameters replace 227 output groups, yielding 1,669 total. This is more informative than rank 6 because rank 7 is the largest eligible correction and therefore the minimum-loss test of cross-map structure, while all 16 GELU units remain.
